strings.FHH_NEU_CONTROL: {fhh_getnamedef} is controlled by A NEUTRAL PARTY.
strings.FHH_mastery_of_intelligence_desc: Reinhard Gehlen is not famed for his genius - of course, that's exactly how he would have it. In reality, Gehlen is perhaps the most talented intelligence officer in Europe, and utilizes his skills to greatly bolster his forces' capabilities.
strings.FHH_safe_sane_secure_desc: Gehlen has established his territory as a safe haven for those fleeing SS persecution. Reformists and conservatives alike flock to his lands, finding common cause in defending the Fatherland from Himmler's bloody grasp.
